_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Raan kuɔɔny vs Dealer

📖 GAME OVERVIEW:
• Yi ciɛl kuɔny {start_chips}
• Kuɔɔny 52 kɔ̈ɔ̈c (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Raan kuɔɔny vs Dealer
• Thiɛ̈ɛ̈l kɔ̈ɔ̈c Ultimate Texas Hold'em: yi ciɛl ANTE kuɔɔny, BLIND kuɔɔny, yi ciɛl 2 kɔ̈ɔ̈c, kuɔɔny PLAY kuɔɔny, kuɔɔny community kɔ̈ɔ̈c, yi ciɛl kɔ̈ɔ̈c thiɛ̈ɛ̈l.
• Yi ciɛl kɔ̈ɔ̈c kuɔɔny ciɛl (LOSS) kuɔɔny yi ciɛl 1000 thiɛ̈ɛ̈l (WIN)

💰 BETTING STRUCTURE:
• ANTE: Kuɔɔny ${ante} kuɔɔny thiɛ̈ɛ̈l
• BLIND: Kuɔɔny ${ante} kuɔɔny thiɛ̈ɛ̈l
• PLAY: Kuɔɔny kuɔɔny. Thiɛ̈ɛ̈l kɔ̈ɔ̈c, yi ciɛl kuɔɔny ciɛl (${ante4} PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} FLOP, ${ante} RIVER. Kuɔɔny kuɔɔny fold RIVER, kuɔɔny kuɔɔny hand, kuɔɔny kuɔɔny bet.)

🎴 CARD DEALING:
• Yi ciɛl 2 kɔ̈ɔ̈c (yi ciɛl kɔ̈ɔ̈c)
• Dealer ciɛl 2 kɔ̈ɔ̈c (kuɔɔny yi ciɛl)
• 5 community kɔ̈ɔ̈c ciɛl kuɔɔny
• Community kɔ̈ɔ̈c ciɛl thiɛ̈ɛ̈l kɔ̈ɔ̈c

🏆 DEALER QUALIFICATION:
• Dealer ciɛl PAIR (2 kɔ̈ɔ̈c ciɛl) kuɔɔny, 2 kɔ̈ɔ̈c ciɛl kuɔɔny 5 community kɔ̈ɔ̈c.
• Dealer qualification ciɛl kuɔɔny betting outcomes.

🎮 GAME PHASES & ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Actions: [4x] (${ante4}) kuɔɔny [check]
  • [4x]: Kuɔɔny ${ante4} PLAY kuɔɔny, ciɛl 3 community kɔ̈ɔ̈c
  • [check]: Kuɔɔny kuɔɔny, ciɛl 3 community kɔ̈ɔ̈c

📋 FLOP:
  • 4x kuɔɔny: Kuɔɔny [skip] ciɛl (auto-ciɛl last 2 community kɔ̈ɔ̈c)
  • Kuɔɔny 4x kuɔɔny: [2x] (${ante2}) kuɔɔny [check]
  • [2x]: Kuɔɔny ${ante2} PLAY kuɔɔny, ciɛl last 2 community kɔ̈ɔ̈c
  • [check]: Kuɔɔny kuɔɔny, ciɛl last 2 community kɔ̈ɔ̈c

📋 RIVER:
  • 4x kuɔɔny kuɔɔny 2x kuɔɔny: Kuɔɔny [skip] ciɛl (auto-proceeds kuɔɔny showdown)
  • Kuɔɔny prior PLAY kuɔɔny: [1x] (${ante}) kuɔɔny [fold]
  • [1x]: Kuɔɔny ${ante} PLAY kuɔɔny, proceeds kuɔɔny showdown
  • [fold]: Kuɔɔny hand, kuɔɔny ANTE kuɔɔny BLIND kuɔɔny

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Kɔ̈ɔ̈c ciɛl kuɔɔny evaluated
  • Best 5 kɔ̈ɔ̈c ciɛl 7 kɔ̈ɔ̈c (2 kɔ̈ɔ̈c + 5 community kɔ̈ɔ̈c)
  • Bets settled kuɔɔny payout rules

💎 BET PAYOUTS:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer ciɛl qualify: PUSH (kuɔɔny returned)
  • Dealer qualify & yi ciɛl win: 1:1 payout (kuɔɔny + winnings)
  • Dealer qualify & yi ciɛl lose: Kuɔɔny lost
  • Tie: PUSH (kuɔɔny returned)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Unaffected kuɔɔny dealer qualification
  • Yi ciɛl win: Kuɔɔny returned kuɔɔny additional payout kuɔɔny hand strength
  • Yi ciɛl lose: Kuɔɔny lost
  • Tie: PUSH (kuɔɔny returned)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Kuɔɔny additional payout

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Unaffected kuɔɔny dealer qualification
  • Direct comparison: Yi ciɛl best hand vs Dealer's best hand
  • Yi ciɛl win: 1:1 payout (kuɔɔny + winnings)
  • Yi ciɛl lose: Kuɔɔny lost
  • Tie: PUSH (kuɔɔny returned)

🎯 POKER HAND RANKINGS (Best kuɔɔny Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 ciɛl suit
  2. Straight Flush: 5 consecutive kɔ̈ɔ̈c ciɛl suit
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 kɔ̈ɔ̈c ciɛl rank
  4. Full House: 3 ciɛl kind + 2 ciɛl kind
  5. Flush: 5 kɔ̈ɔ̈c ciɛl suit
  6. Straight: 5 consecutive kɔ̈ɔ̈c
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 kɔ̈ɔ̈c ciɛl rank
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs ciɛl different ranks
  9. One Pair: 2 kɔ̈ɔ̈c ciɛl rank
  10. High Card: Highest kɔ̈ɔ̈c wins

⌨️  ACTION COMMANDS:
• [4x] kuɔɔny [play bet 4x]: Kuɔɔny ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY kuɔɔny
• [2x] kuɔɔny [play bet 2x]: Kuɔɔny ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY kuɔɔny
• [1x] kuɔɔny [play bet 1x]: Kuɔɔny ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY kuɔɔny
• [check] kuɔɔny [c]: Check (kuɔɔny additional bet)
• [fold] kuɔɔny [f]: Fold (kuɔɔny hand)
• [skip] kuɔɔny [s]: Skip kuɔɔny next phase (kuɔɔny action needed)

💡 STRATEGY TIPS:
• Strong starting hands (pairs, high kɔ̈ɔ̈c) ciɛl justify 4x kuɔɔny
• Consider dealer qualification - weak hands ciɛl push kuɔɔny dealer ciɛl qualify
• BLIND kuɔɔny ciɛl profitable kuɔɔny strong hands (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Watch yi ciɛl kuɔɔny stack! Kuɔɔny ciɛl 0 kuɔɔny below kuɔɔny start kuɔɔny round, yi ciɛl lose.

⚠️  IMPORTANT NOTES:
• ANTE kuɔɔny BLIND kuɔɔny ciɛl mandatory kuɔɔny round
• PLAY kuɔɔny ciɛl optional kuɔɔny strategic
• Make sure yi ciɛl input correct action, kuɔɔny one action kuɔɔny time.
